Meta's AI Assistant Muse Faces Scrutiny Over Hype and Features

Meta's AI assistant, Muse, has become the subject of discussion regarding its perceived hype, user complaints, and ongoing controversies. The company is testing a new feature where human contractors handle phone calls for the AI assistant, a move initiated after Muse's public launch. Separately, Meta's Muse AI Agent has been linked to a rally in chip stocks.
